title: Intent envelope
description: What the organization hands a domain: a desired outcome and its constraints, never how to achieve it, and nothing of the initiative's internals. Contract version 0.1.

id.description: Lets the domain cite the intent in its signals, if it wants to.

work_unit_ref.description: The receiving domain's own reference for where the outcome lands, when the work is already in its custody.

inputs.description: Results the outcome should build on, located by whoever holds them now.

ref.description: That domain's own reference for it.
